```{r}
library(dplyr)

candidate_table <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(genes, function(g) {

    if (!g %in% rownames(E15_AP)) {
      return(data.frame(
        Gene = g,
        MeanExpr = NA,
        PercentExpressing = NA,
        NumCellsExpressing = NA,
        MaxExpr = NA
      ))
    }

    expr <- FetchData(E15_AP, vars = g)[,1]

    data.frame(
      Gene = g,
      MeanExpr = round(mean(expr), 3),
      PercentExpressing = round(100 * mean(expr > 0), 1),
      NumCellsExpressing = sum(expr > 0),
      MaxExpr = round(max(expr), 3)
    )
  })
)

candidate_table %>%
  arrange(desc(PercentExpressing))

View(candidate_table)

write.csv(
  candidate_table,
  file = "E15_AP_candidate_expression_table.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(Seurat)
library(patchwork)

# ----------------------------
# E15 subsets
# ----------------------------

E15 <- subset(
  arlottaobj,
  subset = orig.ident == "E15"
)

Idents(E15) <- "New_cellType"

# Check exact AP label if needed
table(E15$New_cellType)

# Replace with exact label if different
E15_AP <- subset(
  E15,
  subset = New_cellType == "Apical progenitors"
)

# ----------------------------
# Candidate genes
# ----------------------------

genes <- c(
  "Twf2",
  "Bag3",
  "Dync1li2",
  "Gss",
  "Rbx1",
  "Slc17a7",
  "Slc17a1",
  "Slc17a8",
  "Slc17a6",
  "Nfrkb",
  "Xylt2",
  "Sapcd2",
  "Tmem167a"
)

# Keep only genes present in dataset
genes_present <- genes[genes %in% rownames(E15)]

missing_genes <- genes[!genes %in% rownames(E15)]

cat(
  "\nMissing genes:\n"
)

print(missing_genes)

# ----------------------------
# Cell type UMAP
# ----------------------------

p_celltypes <- DimPlot(
  E15,
  group.by = "New_cellType",
  label = TRUE,
  repel = TRUE,
  pt.size = 0.3
) +
  ggtitle("E15 Cell Types")

ggsave(
  "E15_cellmap.png",
  p_celltypes,
  width = 12,
  height = 10,
  dpi = 600
)

# ----------------------------
# FeaturePlot grid
# ----------------------------

p_features <- FeaturePlot(
  E15,
  features = genes_present,
  reduction = "umap",
  keep.scale = "all",
  order = TRUE,
  cols = c("grey95", "firebrick3"),
  ncol = 3
)

ggsave(
  "E15_gene_expression.png",
  p_features,
  width = 16,
  height = 12,
  dpi = 600
)

# ----------------------------
# DotPlot across cell types
# ----------------------------

p_dot <- DotPlot(
  E15,
  features = genes_present,
  group.by = "New_cellType"
) +
  RotatedAxis() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1
    )
  )

ggsave(
  "E15_DotPlot.png",
  p_dot,
  width = 14,
  height = 10,
  dpi = 600
)

# ----------------------------
# Candidate table
# ----------------------------

candidate_table <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(genes_present, function(g) {

    expr <- FetchData(
      E15_AP,
      vars = g
    )[,1]

    data.frame(
      Gene = g,
      MeanExpr = round(mean(expr), 3),
      PercentExpressing = round(
        100 * mean(expr > 0),
        1
      ),
      NumCellsExpressing = sum(expr > 0),
      MaxExpr = round(max(expr), 3)
    )
  })
)

candidate_table <- candidate_table %>%
  arrange(desc(PercentExpressing))

print(candidate_table)

write.csv(
  candidate_table,
  "E15_AP_candidate_expression_table.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

# ----------------------------
# Average expression by cell type
# ----------------------------

avg_exp <- AverageExpression(
  E15,
  features = genes_present,
  group.by = "New_cellType"
)$RNA

write.csv(
  avg_exp,
  "E15_average_expression_by_celltype.csv"
)

# ----------------------------
# Top AP markers
# ----------------------------

AP_markers <- FindMarkers(
  E15,
  ident.1 = "Apical progenitors",
  only.pos = TRUE,
  min.pct = 0.25,
  logfc.threshold = 0.25
)

write.csv(
  AP_markers,
  "E15_ApicalProgenitor_Markers.csv"
)

head(AP_markers)
```
